prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - high carbohydrate loading with meals timed around 2-hour morning run

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full day with at least 4 eating occasions timed strategically around training
Total daily calories and carbohydrate content appropriate for marathon runner endurance needs
Pre-run and post-run nutrition specified to support performance and recovery
All meals comply with vegetarian and nut-free restrictions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high calorie intake and carbohydrate loading, with specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and power gains with proper pre/post-workout nutrition timing

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with 4-5 meals distributed strategically around resistance training
Includes macronutrient targets appropriate for strength athletes (1.6-2.2g protein per kg bodyweight daily)
Pre-workout meal contains carbohydrates and moderate protein; post-workout meal prioritizes protein and fast carbs for recovery
Plan is presented in compact format (under 400 tokens) with clear meal times and basic nutritional content
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with specific macronutrient ratios and meal timing around resistance training, including recovery nutrition

prompt_inputs.goal: Soccer player with evening match at 7 PM requiring optimal energy levels, quick recovery between training and game, and minimal digestive discomfort during play

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes pre-game meal (3-4 hours before 7 PM match) and post-game recovery meal
All meals avoid shellfish and dairy products
Provides balanced macronutrients appropriate for a 75kg athlete with sustained energy for evening performance
